name: whisper-small-sk
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-small (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of openai/whisper-small, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.242 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-20.

benchmarks.name: Common Voice 24 test WER
benchmarks.config: Card 'Before vs. after fine-tuning' table, row 'openai/whisper-small' 58.33% vs 'kinit/whisper-small-sk' 14.15%. CV24 test split, 5,239 samples, public. Caveat: Mozilla Common Voice 24 is listed as a training source, so train/test separation is not stated on the card.

benchmarks.name: KInIT internal held-out WER
benchmarks.config: Same table, base 47.90%. 9,317 samples held out of the KInIT corpus, one third clean / two thirds noise-augmented, not public. In-domain by construction.
